tasks.label: Black (check)
tasks.command: mkdir -p logs/code_quality/black_logs && .venv/bin/python -m black --verbose --diff sources/ tests/ | tee logs/code_quality/black_logs/black_check.log

tasks.label: Isort (check)
tasks.command: mkdir -p logs/code_quality/isort_logs && .venv/bin/python -m isort --check-only --diff --verbose sources/ tests/ | tee logs/code_quality/isort_logs/isort_check.log

tasks.label: Isort (apply)
tasks.command: mkdir -p logs/code_quality/isort_logs && .venv/bin/python -m isort --verbose sources/ tests/ | tee logs/code_quality/isort_logs/isort_check.log

tasks.label: Flake8 (lint)
tasks.command: mkdir -p logs/code_quality/flake8_logs && .venv/bin/python -m flake8 sources/ tests/ --max-line-length=88 --statistics --count --show-source | tee logs/code_quality/flake8_logs/flake8_check.log
